labels.notes: Unmarked, and the REPORT row is partial. Both are correct. The paper's statement (l.717) is inf F_g > 0. This file proves one functional-analytic step of the proof (the appeal to Rellich-Kondrachov at l.720), not the lemma. The REPORT's hypothesis rows are accurate. I read each statement against the TARGET BLOCK, clause by clause. (1) THE CRITERION. totallyBounded_of_approx_finiteRank (l.144) assumes: for every eps > 0 there are Y : Type u (universe-polymorphic; my probe instantiated Type 0), a real seminormed Y, T : Y ->L[R] E, and B : Set Y, with FiniteDimensional R (range T), IsBounded B, and every x in S within dist <= eps of some T b with b in B. It concludes TotallyBounded S, for any real normed E. Y, T and B may depend on eps, which is more general than one fixed T. Writing <= eps instead of < eps changes nothing under 'for every eps'. Its Lp reading totallyBounded_Lp_of_approx_finiteRank (l.211) holds in Lp F p mu for any real normed F and any p with [Fact (1 <= p)]. That includes p = infinity, so it is wider than the target's Lp R p mu with 1 <= p < infinity. isCompact_closure_(Lp_)of_approx_finiteRank adds CompleteSpace, which R satisfies. (2) THE SEQUENCE HALF. The title's sentence holds literally on functions by composing exists_subseq_tendsto_eLpNorm_of_totallyBounded with totallyBounded_Lp_of_approx_finiteRank. My probe 3 did this in one term (F = R, Y : Type, a general finite-rank T, MemLp u_k, conclusion MemLp f p mu and eLpNorm (u (phi k) - f) p mu -> 0). exists_subseq_tendsto_eLpNorm_of_approx_bdd uses the coefficient form c |-> sum_{i in s} c i * g i with |c i| <= K. This is not narrower: take a basis of the finite-dimensional range T. The coordinate functionals are continuous, so they are bounded on T '' B, and every instance of the general hypothesis gives an instance of this one. exists_subseq_tendsto_eLpNorm_of_approx assumes an L^p bound plus approximation by a finite span with free coefficients. Both follow from the target's hypothesis (T '' B is bounded and lies in range T), so this is a relaxation. RELAXATIONS ARE REAL. In both function forms, AEStronglyMeasurable (u k) replaces MemLp (u k), and MemLp is derived in the proof: in _bdd from the eps = 1 approximant, in _of_approx from the bound. No hypothesis is added: mu is arbitrary, the index type beta is arbitrary, and the g's and s vary with eps. NON-VACUITY. approx_of_totallyBounded (l.342, proved) shows that every sequence of MemLp functions with totally bounded classes satisfies the hypotheses of _of_approx (with coefficients in {0,1}). My probe 4 checked a concrete instance of _bdd: the constant sequence 1 on R under dirac 0, with beta = Unit and s = {()}; it is closed by simp. totallyBounded_iff_isBounded_and_approx (l.188) proves the claimed sharpness. (3) THE p = 2 FORM AND Mfd.rellich_kondrachov. Its conclusion (Rellich.lean:481-484) is: exists phi, StrictMono phi and exists f : M -> R, MemLp f 2 mu and Tendsto (fun k => eLpNorm (u (phi k) - f) 2 mu) atTop (nhds 0). My probe stated, inside namespace Yamabe.Mfd and with Rellich.lean's variables, `example ... : type_of% (rellich_kondrachov g hmu u hu hb) := Yamabe.exists_subseq_tendsto_eLpNorm_two u hm hb2 happrox`. It elaborates. `with_reducible exact` also succeeds, so the two conclusions agree syntactically up to reducible unfolding, not only up to defeq. A later assembly can therefore close rellich_kondrachov's goal by `exact` once it produces hm, hb2 (an L^2 bound, immediate from w12) and happrox (the manifold half).

findings.what: SCOPE lists 'the bound on the cell averages' among the work the manifold half still owes. The file's own exists_subseq_tendsto_eLpNorm_of_approx and exists_subseq_tendsto_eLpNorm_two take arbitrary coefficients and need no such bound. The REPORT's notes say so: 'in the bounded form it no longer needs the bound on the averages'. The SCOPE therefore overstates what remains. This is conservative, not an overclaim, but the ledger reads SCOPE blocks into the paper's disclosure.

summary: Clean on substance. Every statement is at least as general as the target block asks: any real normed space or Lp F p mu, p = infinity included, AEStronglyMeasurable in place of MemLp, and T, B, Y allowed to depend on eps. None is vacuous: approx_of_totallyBounded and a concrete instance prove this. The p = 2 form's conclusion is syntactically Mfd.rellich_kondrachov's (with_reducible probe). The file builds under warningAsError with 0 sorry and standard axioms on all 17 declarations. lem:positivity is correctly unmarked and partial, and the scope is clean. There are two minor docstring items.
